result.summary: Found 1 minor styling inconsistency in the restaurant cards within the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: The first restaurant card (Green Bowl Poké) in the 'Fastest near you' section has a light grey background, while the subsequent cards (Smash Bros Burgers, Trattoria Piccol...) have dark backgrounds, creating a visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the background color of the first card to match the dark style of the other cards for uniformity.
